title: Generic Stack
description: Write a Zig program that implements a generic (comptime-polymorphic) stack data structure with push, pop, and peek operations.
hints: Zig uses comptime polymorphism: a function returning `type` creates a generic type
The `Stack(T)` function returns a struct type parameterized by T
`?T` as the return type of pop makes it an optional, returning null when empty
Use `Stack(T){}` to instantiate the struct with specific type T
